caption_L1: This line diagram is called Median wealth in the U.S. Congress from 2008 to 2018 , by chamber (in million U.S. dollars). caption_L2L3: From 2008 the median wealth of the Senate gradually rose until 2015 and thereafter it quite rapidly decreased until it was the same level in 2018 as it was in 2008.
